KL.direction: KL(student || teacher) = mean_i sum_k student_prob[i,k] * (log student_prob[i,k] - log soft[i,k]) (student-first, dung chu mission + v101 student_spec).
KL.formula_torch: student_logprob = log_softmax(student_logits, dim=1); teacher_prob = clamp(soft_targets, 1e-12, 1.0); kl_per_row = (exp(student_logprob) * (student_logprob - log(teacher_prob))).sum(1); KL = kl_per_row.mean() tren soft-subset (train) / val-soft-subset (monitor).
